settings.name: Boarage PDP
settings.paragraph: Design tokens for the Boarage product page sections. Every value has a sensible default; the sections also work when this group is missing.

use_theme_fonts.label: Use the theme's fonts
use_theme_fonts.info: When enabled, the Boarage sections inherit the theme's heading and body fonts. Disable it to pick separate fonts below.

base_size.label: Base font size
base_size.info: Body text size on all devices. 18 px is the minimum for a 60+ audience.

color_cool.label: Cool tint (left half of the sensation panel, icon circles)

color_warm.label: Warm tint (right half of the sensation panel)

color_bg.label: Page background
color_bg.info: Leave empty to keep the theme's background colour.

dark_mode.label: Colour scheme for the Boarage sections
dark_mode.info: The theme's header and footer have no dark mode, so 'Off' is the safe default.

common.empty_info: Empty settings render nothing on the storefront. In the editor they show a dashed placeholder with the setting's name.

heading.label: Headline
heading.info: Leave empty to hide the headline.

image_alt.label: Image alt text
image_alt.info: Describe the image for screen readers and search engines.

cta_link.label: Button link (optional)
cta_link.info: Leave empty to scroll to the buy box on the product page.

panel.paragraph: Two labelled halves (cool | warm) with a title and a short text each, plus a start and an end label on the axis underneath.

options.surface: Light surface with a bottom line

text.label: Item text
text.info: One short phrase, e.g. a guarantee, support or payment note.

settings.paragraph: Product title, images, prices and variants come from the product in the Shopify admin. Everything else is a setting below. Only one buy box per page.

sticky_gallery.label: Keep the gallery in view on desktop

show_rating.label: Show the star rating
show_rating.info: Renders only when a reviews app has filled the reviews.rating metafield. If an app block is added to this section, the app block is shown instead.

subtitle.label: Subtitle under the product title
subtitle.info: One or two sentences. Line breaks are kept.

bundle_legend.label: Bundle selector legend
bundle_legend.info: Short label above the variant cards.

price_mode.label: Price model
price_mode.info: Bundle total: the variant price is the price of the whole bundle; the per-unit price is price ÷ the variant metafield custom.units_per_variant. Per unit: the variant price is the price per unit; the total is price × units and the cart receives that many units.

options.bundle_total: Variant price is the bundle total

per_unit_label.label: Per-unit label
per_unit_label.info: Shown after the computed unit price, e.g. the word for 'per jar'. The unit line is hidden until the variant metafield custom.units_per_variant is filled.

cta_label.label: Add-to-cart button text
cta_label.info: Leave empty to use the theme's default add-to-cart text. Bundle blocks can override it per variant.

options.drawer: Open the theme's cart drawer or notification (falls back to the cart page)
options.cart: Always go to the cart page

sticky_bar.label: Show the mobile sticky buy bar

sticky_cta_label.label: Sticky bar button text
sticky_cta_label.info: Leave empty to reuse the add-to-cart button text.

bundle.name: Bundle card text
bundle.paragraph: Decorates one variant card. Matched by variant title, or by position when the title field is empty (first block = first variant).

match.label: Variant title to match (optional)
match.info: Exact variant title as in the Shopify admin. Leave empty to match by position.

name.label: Card name
name.info: Leave empty to show the variant title.

badge.label: Badge text
badge.info: Small pill on the card's corner. Leave empty for no badge.

cta_label.label: Add-to-cart text for this variant
cta_label.info: Leave empty to use the section's button text.

preselect.label: Preselect this variant
preselect.info: Applies when the page is opened without a variant in the URL.

first_open.label: Open the first item by default

settings.paragraph: Add your reviews app as an app block, or fill the manual review blocks. The section renders nothing on the storefront while both are empty.

text.label: Review text
text.info: Only reviews with permission from the customer.

settings.paragraph: Entries with both a question and an answer are shown and added to the FAQPage structured data.

label.label: Stage label
label.info: Small label above the title, e.g. a step name.

disclaimer.label: Disclaimer (optional)
disclaimer.info: Small muted text under the explainer.

settings.card_paragraph: A purely visual card that mirrors a printed card shipped with the product: title, hint, two labelled 1–10 scales and two free-text lines.

when.label: When
when.info: Short label for the moment, e.g. a day or week.

settings.paragraph: Column blocks are the table headers (the first one is you). Row blocks hold one value per column. 'yes', 'no' and 'varies' (or ja / nein / teils) get styled icons.

column.name: Column
column.paragraph: The first column block is highlighted as your product.

row.name: Row
row.paragraph: Values in column order. Type yes, no or varies for a styled icon, or any short text.

badge_number.label: Badge number
badge_number.info: Large text in the round seal, e.g. a number of days.

settings.paragraph: Legal links, the full INCI list and the product category line. Links need both a label and a link to show.

category_line.label: Product category line
category_line.info: Short sentence, e.g. that it is a cosmetic product for external use.
